question: ‘Both Feet on the Ground’ is an autobiography of which of the following players?
solution:
The correct answer is __**David Beckham**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Both Feet on the Ground i**s the autobiography of** David Beckham,** a former soccer player.
 
• The book is a** rags-to-riches story of Beckham's life**, from his childhood in East London to his rise to become the world's most famous soccer player
 
• David Robert Joseph Beckham is an **English former professional footballer**
 
• **He Known for his precision in free kicks, passing, and crossing,** Beckham played for top clubs like Manchester United, Real Madrid, LA Galaxy, AC Milan, and Paris Saint-Germain.
